question: Analyze the past performance of all the asset types, stock, commodity, real estate, forex and propose which type of asset is worth to invest in based on investors' risk apetite
query: SELECT      MAX(CASE WHEN stock_index LIKE '%Stock%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Stock_Asset_Performance,     MAX(CASE WHEN stock_index LIKE '%Commodity%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Commodity_Asset_Performance,     MAX(CASE WHEN stock_index LIKE '%Real Estate%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Real_Estate_Asset_Performance,     MAX(CASE WHEN stock_index LIKE '%Forex%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Forex_Asset_Performance FROM finance_economics_dataset LIMIT 50;  Note: This query will return a single row with the performance metrics for each asset type. To analyze historical performance, you can join this result with date and price columns for a time-series analysis.  To recommend investment based on risk appetite:  1. Consider Stock Assets:    - High volatility (e.g., crude oil)    - Higher potential returns    - Requires careful risk management  2. Consider Commodity Assets:    - Medium volatility    - Can hedge against inflation    - Suitable for diversified portfolios  3. Consider Real Estate Assets:    - Lower volatility historically    - Provides income through rent    - Good for long-term investment  4. Consider Forex Assets:    - High volatility    - Requires sophisticated risk management    - Best suited for experienced investors  The recommended asset type should align with your risk tolerance and investment horizon, taking into account historical performance patterns.
